name: nextcore
description: Skills distilled from a production product built and run by AI coding agents: design, development contract, and agent operations.

plugins.name: nextcore-design
plugins.description: Design-first for AI agents: spec and hierarchy first, draw before code, a critic agent, then measure (slop-check, token-audit, design-card, design-review).

plugins.name: nextcore-dev
plugins.description: The development contract that makes design and code meet: field map to API shape, auth on every route, money and data changes, background jobs, backend measurement traps.

plugins.name: nextcore-workflow
plugins.description: Running AI coding agents on a real product: diagnose before patching, evidence before claims, parallel agents and accounts, docs that expire (doc-drift).
